decisions.reason: The spacing change applies to the landing-page visual system but does not change the How It Works section's position, sequential presentation, or steps.
Increasing spacing between sections does not necessarily change the requirement for responsive landing-page behavior.
The source changes visual spacing, not which copy or content is included on the landing page.
The section-spacing adjustment does not change the sign-up button's action or control type.
The source addresses spacing on the landing page and does not require that spacing change to propagate to follow-on pages or shared page chrome.
The dashboard-access discussion is a future work arrangement; the concrete spacing decision applies only to the landing page and does not alter console-shell styling.
A landing-page section-spacing adjustment does not change the established cross-page breakpoint or responsive guidance.
The source does not discuss provisioning-wizard spacing, orientation, controls, or visual specifications.
The landing-page spacing change does not affect the Cognito sign-in page's Actia branding requirement.
Changing applied spacing between landing-page sections does not itself revise the requested design-system spacing scale or other specification deliverables.
The source does not change footer sharing, content, links, or its role as the site-navigation location.
The visual spacing adjustment does not change the plain HTML, Tailwind CSS, or no-Astro implementation choices.
